title: Bar chart in plain SVG
when: The user wants to compare values across categories (sales by month, votes per option, top products) as bars, without a chart library.
prompt:
Goal: A crisp, labeled SVG bar chart built from data with a zero baseline, readable labels and a text alternative.
Steps:
1. viewBox 0 0 640 360 with margins (top 20, right 16, bottom 48, left 56); CSS width 100%, height auto.
2. y from 0 to a nice max (1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten); bar height = value / max * plot height.
3. Bands: step = plot width / n, bar width = step * 0.7, offset step * 0.15.
4. Create nodes with createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect") and setAttribute; labels via textContent.
5. Draw 4 or 5 gridlines with tick labels, category labels under bars (horizontal bars when names are long) and value labels.
6. One fill color; the accent only on a bar that carries the message. Add role="img" and a <title> stating the takeaway.
Quality bar:
- Sorted by value unless the order is natural, such as months.
- Labels at least 12 px rendered.
- Bars reach 3 to 1 contrast with the background.
Pitfalls:
- A y axis not starting at zero, which exaggerates gaps.
- Rainbow colors with no meaning.
- Overlapping labels on phones.
Verify:
- [ ] svg has viewBox, role="img" and a title.
- [ ] Bars start at zero.
- [ ] Values readable as text.
- [ ] No innerHTML with data.
Output: js/bar-chart.js exporting barChart(container, data, options) and chart CSS.

examples.input: gráfico de barras das vendas por mês
examples.output: barChart with 12 month bars, y ticks 0 to 50k, title "Sales peaked in December"
